content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for ICAR-CCARI Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Age relaxation, Research Associate: Maximum 40 years for men and 45 years for women; relaxation as per Government rules. Age relaxation, Young Professional-I: Relaxation as per government rules. Other conditions: Appointment on full-time basis; no other assignment allowed during the engagement Candidates whose near or distant relative is an ICAR-CCARI employee must declare it Desirable: Research Associate: Diploma in IPR and/or experience in IP management, technology transfer and commercialization activities under ITMU Research Associate: Proficiency in MS Office, database applications and AI tools for technology management, research and IPR protection Young Professional-I: M.Sc. in Biotechnology/ Microbiology, minimum one year of experience as research project staff Young Professional-I: Working knowledge of MS Office, excel, molecular biology techniques and analysis of genomic data

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary, under projects Research Associate: up to 31-03-2027 or until completion of the project Young Professional-I: up to 31-03-2027 or extendable as per project duration subject to satisfactory performance Services end automatically with the termination of the Project/Scheme, or earlier at the discretion of the Competent Authority Director can terminate with one month's notice or one month's emoluments; candidate leaving must give one month's notice and one month's emoluments are withheld as caution money No claim to regular employment at ICAR-CCARI or any other ICAR Institute

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ICAR-CCARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CCARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Research Associate, 1 Young Professional-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICAR-CCARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ICAR-CCARI, Old Goa.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Research Associate: maximum 40 years for men and 45 years for women; Young Professional-I: 21 to 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹67,000 per month + HRA (for Ph.D. degree holders); ₹61,000 per month + HRA (for Master's degree holders) for Research Associate, ₹ 30,000 per month for Young Professional-I.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Research Associate: Ph.D. in the relevant subject, or Master's degree in the relevant subject with at least three years of research experience and one SCI / NAAS rated (>=4.0) research paper. Young Professional-I: Graduate in Veterinary Science / B.Sc. Biotechnology / Microbiology. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Appointment on full-time basis; no other assignment allowed during the engagement. Candidates whose near or distant relative is an ICAR-CCARI employee must declare it.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates reaching after 9.00 AM will not be allowed to attend the selection process. Applications in any format other than the institute's form will not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Objective-Type Test of 30-minute duration. Structured Interview. Followed by structured Interview.
